items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: I think Bob Zurke probably was the first piano player, with the Bob Crosby band... hearing Bob Zurke. I was very impressed with him.

ctx.x: Who were some of your favorites in those radio days to listen to?
I was just thinking about that. Well it’s funny, in those days — well I guess, well Bob Zurke probably was the first piano player, with the Bob Crosby band.
